A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

Meet your dimensions.

Parameters are the adjustable numbers in your model: one intercept plus up to four input weights.

2 parameters: a line with one input. 3: a plane with two inputs. 4–5: a higher-dimensional model, shown as a 3D slice with the other inputs held fixed.

Looking for the bowl? Switch to Loss landscape. Linear regression stays flat; its squared-error surface forms a bowl. Move the intercept and first weight to explore it; all other weights stay fixed.

Find the best fit calculates the least-squares solution across every input. Noise changes the observations, not the model.

Drag 3D plots to rotate, scroll to zoom, or focus the graph and use arrow keys and +/−. “Reset view” restores the camera.
